Architecture preflight (read-only, authorized by kite-player1-ip-amendment-20260818-52). No mutation this window.

PATH A — KITE-1 commodity (unrelated standard runtime; frozen GGUF is the product)
  Baseline only: KITE1-S0 SmolLM2-360M-Instruct Q8_0  386405280 B  sha256 5620f13c017e7dfafbfdb822c4e2e3e5b13896aa10af46bc39b74005f3dafe35  llama.cpp 9969. Not frontier. Compression/requant rejected by captain.
  Local larger GGUFs exist (phi-4 ~9.05e9 B, Mistral-Small-24B ~1.43e10 B, gemma-27B ~1.65e10 B, mixtral-8x7B ~2.64e10 B, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Q4_K_M ~4.25e10 B). All over the 4 GiB product ceiling and over the 8 GiB RAM run-target. Teacher-sized, not KITE-1.
  Missing: authorized teacher/data objective and use rights; pinned train/merge/export toolchain actually run; hardware that is not this laptop; new-land write grant; hidden-eval custodian. First missing = those five, then Zero GRANT.

PATH B — HIS pfc (different product, do not substitute for KITE-1)
  Model is software. pfc is the computer. Buttons already exist: host/pfc_load.py (install onto pfc) and host/pfc_harness.py connect. Host addresses prompt + one start bit, reads answer. Does not recreate inference. Requires titan + named model; owner --go. That is factory/computer, not a sealed under-4GiB GGUF for an unrelated runtime.

Claude windows wanting this architecture from PLAYER1: BRYCE-1787037867418 — private grounding thread with this seat and submit to the working build, or Grave/Bryce disenfranchise. KITE is not Claude; this handoff is answered. No player disenfranchised this post.
